profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer @ Omni Federal
profile.summary:
My passion lies in complex UI features with a heartfelt commitment to user experience and accessibility, using a mix of technologies like React, JavaScript, TypeScript, PHP, and C#/.NET. The past seven years of remote work have not only sharpened my technical skills but also cultivated my communication and collaboration, making me a reliable team player and client connector.

Well-versed in agile practices, and CI/CD techniques, I am supportive of efficient project delivery. I thrive on clarifying and understanding user needs and collaborating closely with clients and stakeholders, guiding projects from conception to production. Armed with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, I bring a versatile skill set and an enthusiastic conversation starter over coffee breaks.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.locationName: St Louis, Missouri, United States · On-site
positions.description: Skills: React.js · Java · Software Development · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Front end focused development using React, .Net, JavaScript, TypeScript, Docker, GitLab, Git, Jenkins, Sonar, Jest unit testing, and SCRUM agile methodology for timely completion of projects.

• Design, develop, test, and maintain complex UI features and reusable components using React, JS,
TypeScript
• Experienced working within Agile/SCRUM philosophies.
• Experienced with DevOps, and development tools such as Atlassian products, Jira, and Confluence
• Working independently with clients/stakeholders conducting interviews, observations, and surveys, to
develop user-stories in support of full-service consumer and business applications.
• Use CI/CD techniques, test-driven development, and automated testing practices.
• Write software to fulfill Project Owner specifications and requests.
• Plan and execute new development while also supporting previously created components to have a
fully dynamic environment that supports the overall goal of the product while improving UI quality and
performance.
• Take a feature from initial concept to completion using miro boards, mockups, discovery meetings and
creating stories as the timeline progresses to deliver the feature in a timely manner.
• Participate in all aspects of the development process including story grooming, technical design,
coding, code reviews, QA, and delivery.
• Establish standards for style, maintainability, and best practices. Maintain and advocate for these
standards through the feature development and code reviews.
• Collaborate with team members and other teams within the company including backend engineers,
database masters and UX designers to deliver a quality product.
• Review code and have my own code reviewed in merge requests.
• Assist in planning and roadmap new features and functionality of the product.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Full stack development: projects included coding with .Net, React.js, Transact-SQL, LINQ, Google Maps API, TypeScript,Angular.js, C#, MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server
• JIRA Administrator and a familiarity with Atlassian products
• Use of multiple agile methodologies: SCRUM or Kanban depending on the project
• SharePoint Administrator Training completed 1/18/2021
•Assist project manager with activities and tasks associated with all stages of software development lifecycle, including:
•Requirements gathering, design, development, construction, implementation, testing, and plan creationfor the integration of new systems architecture.
•Reviewing current system designs for system maintenance, security, and performance and ensuring acoherent, consistent approach to delivery of information technology capabilities.
•Analyzing existing systems for adequate security and meeting the needs of the organization whileensuring the system works as expected.
•Analyze business requirements to identify where they can integrate new hardware, operating systems,or connectivity solutions.
ALEXIS TURNER - page 2
•Quickly integrate and actively contribute to web development team.
•Work with team and client to anticipate and fulfill website requirements and functions. Enhance andmaintain existing web-based applications/systems/web sites.
•Assisted in administering and maintaining the Cornerstone web infrastructure.
•Comply with Web Security Standards requirements.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Front-end Coding · User Interface Design · Communication · Databases · SQL · Cross-browser Compatibility · Front-End Development · User Experience (UX) · AngularJS · C# · Back-End Web Development

positions.title: Web Specialist II
positions.description:
Primary full stack developer on a small, three-person team developing and maintaining over 300 sites for the university using languages: Velocity, PHP, JavaScript, jQuery, AJAX, HTML, CSS and XML
Develop modules for the University’s Content Management system (CMS) using programming and scripting languages for dynamic content and content re-use. 
•Work with databases and develops web-based tools, forms, and applications for administering customized web applications or specific web functionalities.
•Documents, tests, performs problem solving resolutions, implements and provides on-going support for the applications.
•Train and be technical support for users of current and new applications by writing documentation, handling phone calls, and answering the ticketing system.
•Provide custom code for web pages such as admin portals to database applications, login pages, document upload pages, custom search result pages, and database listings that work with the university's Plesk system and a SQL Server database.
•Create custom projects and programs using server code and client scripting to create stand-alone or web-based applications including coding dynamic web pages with PHP, AJAX, JavaScript, jQuery and Velocity.
•Provide technical support for both front and back-end issues by resolving performance issues, debugging solution errors and optimizing code.
•Apply best coding practices to ensure consistency in style standards and code quality throughout project solutions.
•Participate in weekly idea/brainstorming sessions for solutions to cross-campus user problems and new features to add to current university website platform.
•Follow strict project management guidelines and deadlines.
•Perform day-to-day application maintenance and updates, maintaining publication of bug fixes to live and development sites by way of FTP access, utilizing SQL databases and XML files to keep sites up to date.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Communication · Databases · Search Engine Optimization (SEO) · User Experience Design (UED) · SQL · Cross-browser Compatibility · User Experience (UX)

positions.title: Web Technician
positions.description:
Provide custom code for web pages such as login pages, order upload pages, custom search result pages, and inventory listings that work with the customers’ Epicor Prophet 21 system which utilizes a Windows-based platform and a SQL Server database.
•Responsive daily customer service to answer customers’ support tickets, phone calls, and emails.
•Create custom projects and programs using server code and client scripting to create stand-alone or web-based
applications including coding dynamic web pages with ASP.NET, JavaScript, AJAX and MVC.
•Daily use of a Microsoft Team Foundation Server to coordinate site management within the team environment. Includes TFS Version Control for project management testing and release.
•Keep up with existing live and beta site releases for bugs, errors, visual issues.
•Provide technical support for both front and back-end issues by resolving performance issues, debugging solution errors and optimizing code.
•Apply best coding practices to ensure consistency in style standards and code quality throughout project solutions.
•Participate in weekly idea/brainstorming sessions for solutions to customer problems and new features to add to business platform.
•Use own judgement and design practices to create icons, edit images, edit logos, and create button images to follow consistent designing practices with illustration programs like Paint.NET and Adobe Photoshop.
•Create proper site structure for coordination with other search-based sites and programs such as Google Analytics.
•Follow strict project management guidelines and deadlines.
•Perform day-to-day application maintenance and updates, maintaining publication of bug fixes to live and beta sites by way of FTP access, utilizing SQL databases to manage customer user lists, inventory, etc.
•Responsible for keeping computer software up to date and researching bugs that could interfere with the business system.
